title: Grade 5
summary: Irregular time, tenor clef, four clefs, keys to six sharps/flats, all intervals, transposing instruments, inversions, cadences, ornaments, voices, instruments and score observation.

units.title: Irregular time and divisions
units.summary: 5/4, 7/4, 5/8, 7/8 and irregular divisions of simple time values.

units.title: Tenor clef and the four clefs
units.summary: Tenor clef, reading four clefs and octave transposition between any clefs.
refinements: Instrument transposition (book §12) moves to G5-U3 so that it follows the six-accidental keys and chromatic-interval spelling it depends on.

units.title: Six-accidental keys, all intervals and transposing instruments
units.summary: F♯/G♭ major, D♯/E♭ minor; chromatic and compound intervals; written and concert pitch.

units.title: Inversions, chords and cadences
units.summary: Root position and inversions of I, ii, IV, V; cadences; chords at cadence points.
refinements: The Ic–V (six-four, five-three) progression and approach chords are optional enrichment linked to the core chord and cadence lessons.

units.title: Ornaments, voices, instruments and the score
units.summary: Ornaments, replacing written-out ornaments, voices, instruments and sound production, Grade 5 terms, score observation.
refinements: Book §13 (SATB short/open score transcription) is optional enrichment; voice types are taught as core.

nodes.title: Quintuple and septuple time
nodes.objective: Read 5/4, 7/4, 5/8 and 7/8 as combinations of two- and three-beat groups.

nodes.title: Grouping in irregular time
nodes.objective: Group notes and rests by the stated sub-groups in irregular bars.

nodes.title: Irregular divisions
nodes.objective: Read groups of 5, 6, 7 or 9 notes in the time of a beat and choose the written value.

nodes.title: Practice: Fives and sevens
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: Grade 4 foundations
nodes.objective: Revisit earlier material so it stays fresh.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Fives and sevens
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: The tenor clef
nodes.objective: Read and write notes in the tenor clef, with middle C on the fourth line.

nodes.title: Reading four clefs
nodes.objective: Identify notes in treble, alto, tenor and bass clefs, including key signatures in each.

nodes.title: Octave transposition between any clefs
nodes.objective: Transpose a melody an octave higher or lower into any other clef.

nodes.title: Practice: Four clefs
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Four clefs
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: F sharp major and D sharp minor
nodes.objective: Build F♯ major and D♯ minor (both forms) and write their key signatures in all clefs.

nodes.title: G flat major and E flat minor
nodes.objective: Build G♭ major and E♭ minor and see that they are enharmonic with F♯ major and D♯ minor.

nodes.title: Chromatic intervals
nodes.objective: Name intervals whose notes are not in one scale, such as augmented 6ths and diminished 6ths.

nodes.title: Compound intervals
nodes.objective: Name intervals larger than an octave as compound or by number (e.g. 12th).

nodes.title: Written pitch and concert pitch
nodes.objective: Explain why some instruments sound at a different pitch from the written note.

nodes.title: Transposing for B flat, A and F instruments
nodes.objective: Transpose a short melody between concert and written pitch, adjusting the key signature and accidentals.

nodes.title: Practice: Keys, intervals and transposing
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Keys, intervals and transposing
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Inversions of triads
nodes.objective: Recognise root position (5/3), first inversion (6/3) and second inversion (6/4).

nodes.title: The supertonic chord
nodes.objective: Build ii in major and minor keys, noting that it is diminished in minor keys.

nodes.title: Identifying chords and inversions
nodes.objective: Identify I, ii, IV and V in any position in any Grade 5 key.

nodes.title: Perfect, plagal and imperfect cadences
nodes.objective: Recognise the three cadences by their chords in C, G, D and F major.

nodes.title: Hearing and finding cadences
nodes.objective: Identify cadences at the ends of phrases in short original passages.

nodes.title: Choosing chords at cadence points
nodes.objective: Choose chords that fit marked melody notes and make the intended cadence.

nodes.title: The six-four, five-three progression
nodes.objective: Optional: recognise Ic–V over the dominant bass.

nodes.title: Approach chords
nodes.objective: Optional: choose a chord before a two-chord cadence.

nodes.title: Practice: Harmony
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Harmony
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: What ornaments sound like
nodes.objective: Understand how each ornament is usually performed (for recognition, not for writing out).

nodes.title: Replacing written-out ornaments
nodes.objective: Replace a written-out ornament with the correct sign.

nodes.title: Voices
nodes.objective: Name the voice types and order them by range.

nodes.title: How instruments make their sound
nodes.objective: Explain the basic way each family produces sound and the clefs each instrument uses.

nodes.title: More instruments
nodes.objective: Recognise additional orchestral, percussion and non-orchestral instruments and keyboard directions.

nodes.title: Grade 5 terms
nodes.objective: Understand the Grade 5 terms, including German directions.

nodes.title: Exploring a score
nodes.objective: Answer general musical observation questions about an original short score.

nodes.title: Voices in short and open score
nodes.objective: Optional: see how four voice parts are laid out on two staves or four.

nodes.title: Practice: The score in context
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Grade review
nodes.objective: Cumulative spaced review of the whole grade before the unit challenge and grade assessment.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: The score in context
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Grade 5 assessment
nodes.objective: An independent, hint-free assessment that samples every Grade 5 outcome and earlier essentials.
